parole.significato: why; for what reason (used to express strong disagreement)
parole.testo: Literally "from where and until where". Calque of Turkish nereden nereye (“for some reason or other; I don't quite know why”), literally "from where to where".

parole.significato: a meatball of ground meat and rice

parole.testo: Onomatopoeic from Turkish hop (“go on! jump!”)

Borrowed from Turkish pancur, panjur + -ι (-i). Nishanyan derives the Turkish from a French pare-jour (“light-organizing; lattice cage”, literally “adorn-daylight”); however, the French term apparently lacks attestation in texts, in addition to the term bearing strong resemblance to Persian پَنْجَرِ

parole.significato: (to go) to waste, down the drain
parole.testo: Borrowed from Turkish israf (plus στ- from a preceding definite article), from Arabic إِسْرَاف (ʔisrāf).
From Turkish cüce, from Ottoman Turkish جوجه (cüce), from Classical Persian جوجه (jūja, “cub, chick”).

parole.significato: to vex, annoy, irritate, drive around the bend, peeve, rub the wrong way, nettle, get to, tick off, piss off
parole.testo: Borrowed from Turkish çatı(şmak) (“to clash, strike”) + -ίζω (-ízo).

parole.significato: fugitive, mutineer, outlaw; partisan, rebel, insurgent
